newsitem.title: USA: Cavalier Homes sees uncertainty for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Cavalier Homes sees uncertainty for 1997.

text.p: Cavalier Homes Inc said Monday it is uncertain about its revenues and earnings for the rest of the year due to lower inventories and order backlogs and more competitive conditions.
It said there was a 3 percent decline in industry shipments for the first five months of 1997, despite analysts' predictions earlier that industry shipments would grow four to five percent.

Cavalier said it believes the industry is experiencing an greater competitiveness due to the increase in the number of dealers and greater manufacturing capacity, combined with wet weather.This has meant fewer home deliveries, higher dealer inventories, lower order backlogs and more price competition.
The company posted profits of $0.29 a share compared to $0.29 last year. The 1996 share figures was adjusted to a five-for-four split paid in November 1996.
